data.title: Minister of Education Discusses Academic, Investment Cooperation with Duke University
data.content:
Washington, November 21, 2026, SPA -- Minister of Education Yousef Al-Benyan met with representatives from Duke University’s center in Washington to discuss opportunities for strengthening academic and investment cooperation between Saudi educational institutions and the university, as well as avenues for providing educational services within the Kingdom.
    The meeting saw the launch of a partnership between Maarif Education and Duke University, following the activation of a memorandum of understanding between the two parties. The partnership aims to foster collaboration in applied research, academic programs, executive training, and professional development for educators, with plans to establish a university Center of Excellence in the Kingdom.
    The meeting is part of the Ministry of Education's ongoing efforts to bolster cooperation with international institutions and attract global expertise in delivering educational programs and services.
    -- SPA
